purpose: Teach: 角栄/野茂/バチカン/アーセナル/レオナルド/コスタリカ/苫小牧/クウェート

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが田中角栄の伝記をお買いになったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad bought himself a biography of Kakuei Tanaka.
lines.style: Warm, light tone—sharing something charming about Dad's interests. Gentle rhythm. Small smile in the voice, not mocking, just affectionate observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと野茂英雄のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a documentary about Nomo Hideo with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Quick rhythm, genuine excitement bubbling up. Open, unguarded delivery—he wants her to know this happened.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバチカン旅行のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was telling us such interesting things about his trip to the Vatican.
lines.style: Soft, impressed tone. Slight lift on the memory—she's genuinely charmed by what Dad shared. Unhurried delivery, as if savoring the detail.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとアーセナルの試合観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched an Arsenal match with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, quick energy. Eager to report back. Same open confidence as before—he's building a catalogue of shared moments with Dad.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがレオナルド展に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to take you to the Leonardo exhibition.
lines.style: Gentle announcement. Slight excitement underneath—she's delighted by Dad's plan for him. Warm, anticipatory pace. A small gift wrapped in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとコスタリカのコーヒー飲んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I drank Costa Rican coffee with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, confident energy. Same eager rhythm as the others. Quick-paced delight—another small adventure to share with her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが苫小牧で釣りされるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad is going fishing in Tomakomai, apparently.
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Slightly distant—she's registering Dad's plan as another one of his interests. Understated warmth, a gentle drift at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとクウェートの戦争のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a documentary about the Gulf War with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager energy at peak. Quick, genuine excitement. Same rhythm as before but with extra conviction—another moment to treasure.
